title: Mutation testing and test quality
description: Learn about Mutation testing and test quality. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Mutation testing and test quality** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with mutation testing and test quality.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of mutation testing and test quality
Learn practical applications and use cases

data.text: Understanding mutation testing and test quality is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.
